# XZ Embedded

Unmodified decoder sources from [XZ Embedded](https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz-embedded),
tag `v2024-12-30` (commit `ae63ae3a36ed01724674e8f3d750dc47bf125410`), used under the
0BSD license in `COPYING`. Only the XZ/LZMA2 stream decoder with CRC32 checks is built;
it decompresses the embedded path-tracing SPIR-V (see `scripts/shaders/generate.py`).
